scope: cJSON v1.7.19 parse+print through our driver
claim: agreement on 578 tested inputs (seed 1) and None held-out inputs; not a proof of equivalence

held_out.summary_source: not available (report has no summary object)
held_out.rule: generated with seed + 1000, minus any input whose bytes the repair loop saw

verification.claim_matches_host: n/a (verified on the host; no sandbox claim)
verification.verifier: backend/harness/verify.sh (raw stdout bytes and exit codes compared, C side under ASan+UBSan)

known_limitations: Covers parse+print only (cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts and cJSON_PrintUnformatted through our driver), not the full cJSON API or its C ABI.
Output after an embedded NUL byte is not compared: the C driver prints with fputs, so both sides are compared only up to the first NUL.
The banned-API guard (no std::process, std::fs, std::net, Command, include!, ...) is a text scan of cjson.rs, not a sandbox.
Agreement on the tested inputs is not a proof of equivalence: inputs nobody generated can still diverge.
Experimental: produced by a model and checked by our differential verifier; it needs maintainer review before anyone relies on it.
reproduce_unavailable: spec.json has no seed/inputs: cannot write a reproduce script with the same inputs
